channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Apple Arcade update: Sid Meier's Civilization VII coming on Feb 5
item.description: Sid Meier's Civilization VII Arcade Edition will launch on Apple Arcade on February 5, bringing the popular PC strategy franchise to iPhone, iPad, and Mac as part of the subscription service.

item.title: Moody's Ratings upgrades outlook on Adani Ports to stable, reaffirms Baa3 ratings for ATSOL and AEML
item.description: The agency also affirmed the Baa3 senior secured ratings of Adani Transmission Step-One Limited (ATSOL) and Adani Electricity Mumbai Limited (AEML), along with AEML's MTN programme ratings, and changed their outlooks to stable. Moody's expects all three entities to maintain solid access to liquidity and credit metrics supportive of investment-grade ratings over the next 12–18 months,

item.title: BMC polls: Amid raging row over ink being wiped off, SEC orders probe
item.description: SEC ordered a probe into the quality of the indelible ink supplied by Kores and decided to replace it with ink from Mysore Ink. While denying that the ink was erasable after drying, Waghmare said the same marker-pen ink has been used since 2011 and warned that attempts to remove ink or spread misinformation would invite legal action.

item.title: IIM Rohtak Director Prof. Dheeraj Sharma conferred Exemplary Governance Leadership Award
item.description: IIM Rohtak Director Prof. Dheeraj Sharma has been conferred the Exemplary Governance Leadership Award at the 46th World Management Congress for his leadership, governance reforms, and institution-building initiatives.

item.title: Govt extends export incentives to postal shipments to boost MSME sector
item.description: The move is expected to improve competitiveness for MSME exporters, especially those in smaller towns and remote areas, and give a boost to postal exports. The initiative builds on earlier reforms such as electronic processing of postal exports and imports, automated IGST refunds, and the Hub and Spoke model with over 1,000 Dak Niryat Kendras to support cross-border e-commerce.

item.title: Gold, silver prices ease moderately as US dollar gains
item.description: Gold and silver prices slipped on Friday in both domestic and global markets as a stronger US dollar and reduced safe-haven demand weighed on sentiment. MCX gold and silver futures edged lower, while spot prices also declined after silver hit a record high earlier in the session.

item.title: India slams Pakistan for 'abusing' concept of self-determination for attacks on democracies
item.description: India criticised Pakistan at the UN General Assembly for misusing the concept of self-determination to push a divisive agenda by repeatedly raising the Kashmir issue. India's UN counsellor Eldos Punoose said Pakistan abuses UN platforms with baseless allegations and falsehoods, stressing that self-determination cannot be used to encourage secession in democratic and pluralistic states.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty in green amid hopes of India-EU trade deal, lowering crude prices
item.description: As of 9.25 am, Sensex added 239 points, or 0.29 per cent to reach 83,622 and Nifty advanced 50 points, or 0.2 per cent to 25,715. Main broad cap indices performed in line with benchmark indices, with the Nifty Midcap 100 adding 0.35 per cent, and the Nifty Smallcap 100 adding 0.11 per cent.

item.title: Trump announces new phase of Gaza peace plan, supports technocratic governance and Hamas demilitarisation
item.description: Trump said the phase would prioritise a comprehensive demilitarisation of Hamas, including surrender of weapons and dismantling of tunnel networks, with support from Egypt, Turkey and Qatar.

item.title: Hypocrisy: Alia Bhatt urges fans not to fly kites for bird safety on Makar Sankranti; netizens question her Gucci ambassadorship
item.description: On the occasion of Makar Sankranti, Alia Bhatt took to her Instagram story to urge fans not to fly kites, highlighting concerns over bird safety. However, several netizens were quick to point out what they termed hypocrisy, reminding her of her association as a Gucci ambassador, noting that she wears leather clothing and carries bags made from animal skin.
